evals.prompt: Create a reusable bash script for sending GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment notifications to Discord. The script must accept --status, --repo, --branch, --commit, and --run-url arguments, format an embed with dynamic green/red/yellow status colors, support both CLI and env var for the webhook URL, and pass ShellCheck.
evals.expected_output: A complete, executable Bash script adhering to set -euo pipefail, jq-based JSON construction, dual webhook URL resolution, and --dry-run support, accompanied by ShellCheck validation confirmation.
assertions: Script isolates primary execution logic inside a main() function
Script formats JSON using jq rather than raw string interpolation
Script passes shellcheck validation with zero errors or warnings

evals.prompt: Create a cronjob bash script that checks disk and memory usage every 10 minutes and sends a Discord alert only when disk usage exceeds 85% or memory exceeds 90%. It should ping a specific Discord user ID on alerts and output nothing when normal.
evals.expected_output: A production-ready Bash script that gathers system metrics via df and free/top, compares against configurable thresholds, constructs a Discord embed with red color and user mention tag, supports --only-on-alert, and validates cleanly.
assertions: Script gathers disk and memory utilization reliably
Script supports --only-on-alert to suppress normal runs in cron
Script includes dual webhook URL resolution and error handling
Script passes shellcheck validation with zero warnings

evals.prompt: Write a bash script for an automated nightly Postgres backup job that posts a completion report to Discord with database name, archive file size, duration, and if failed, attaches the last 10 lines of the backup log.
evals.expected_output: A robust backup notifier script with --status, --name, --file, --duration, and --log-file options, dynamic embeds, and ShellCheck compliance.
assertions: Script inspects file size using du -h when file path is provided
Script extracts log tail on failure using tail -n
Script uses jq to safely escape multiline log text in code block
Script passes shellcheck validation with zero warnings
